Upstream hash computed from an exact byte reconstruction of the pinned reference copy, since shell access to the reference directory is policy-blocked.

Upstream hash computed from an exact byte reconstruction of the pinned reference copy, since shell access to the reference directory is policy-blocked.

web/src/fava/modals/AddEntryModal.svelte.notes: Fava Add Entry modal reworked for legacy Svelte and the OrangeCount adapter: #add-transaction toggling without the upstream hash store, hand-rolled transaction/balance/note forms instead of upstream Entry classes, and posting through the private add-entries route instead of upstream save_entries. Continue-checkbox persistence matches the upstream add-entry-continue store. Upstream hash computed from an exact byte reconstruction of the pinned reference copy, since shell access to the reference directory is policy-blocked.

web/src/fava/modals/DocumentUploadModal..notes: Fava document-upload modal reworked for legacy Svelte and the OrangeCount adapter: same .droptarget/.dragover document-level drag flow and date-prefixed rename inputs as upstream (helper logic from frontend/src/modals/document-upload.ts, hash 75c4e2134e2b805ce0da6b00a3c8e222db5b33a37319e9c7b693932504b5fbe2), but the folder choice comes from the adapter's configured document roots instead of the ledger documents option, the account input is a datalist instead of AccountInput, and uploads post through the private document route; the upstream uri-list link-drop attach flow (put_attach_document metadata insertion) is not implemented. Upstream hash verified against an exact byte reconstruction of the pinned reference copy.
